Austria Travel.title: 5 Places to See in Zell am See, Austria (Lake, Glacier and Waterfalls)
Austria Travel.description: Zell am See puts a turquoise Alpine lake and a glacier in one trip. Ride up the Kitzsteinhorn to about 3,000 m for snow even in July, then see the Krimml Waterfalls, the highest in Austria. All 5, plus how to get there from Salzburg, in the guide. Switzerland Travel.title: 8 Places to See in Interlaken, Switzerland (Jungfraujoch, Waterfalls and Lakes)
Switzerland Travel.description: Interlaken sits between two turquoise lakes at the foot of the Jungfrau region. Ride up to Jungfraujoch, Europe's highest railway station at 3,454 m, or walk the Lauterbrunnen valley of 72 waterfalls. All 8, plus the best time to go, in the guide. Save this pin for your trip.
